visual_elements.description: Linear ML pipeline diagram. Nodes: (1) Ellipse 'Training Data' (two lines: 'Training' / 'Data'), peach fill #FAD7A0, thin gray-tan outline, top-left. (2) Rectangle 'Pre processing' (two lines: 'Pre' / 'processing'), light-yellow fill #FFFFCC, blue border #0000CC, bold black text. (3) Rectangle 'Feature Extraction' (two lines: 'Feature' / 'Extraction'), light-cyan fill #CCFFFF, blue border #0000CC, bold black text. (4) Rectangle 'Feature Selection' (two lines: 'Feature' / 'Selection'), pale-green fill #E7FFE7, green border #009900, bold black text. (5) Rectangle 'Classification' (one line), dark-red fill #A61C1C, no distinct border, bold WHITE text. (6) Rectangle 'Classifier Output' (two lines: 'Classifier' / 'Output'), tan/brown fill #D9A96A, dark border, bold black text. Arrows (all red #CC0000, left-to-right unless noted): curved arrow from the bottom of the 'Training Data' ellipse down into the left side of 'Pre processing'; straight arrow 'Pre processing' -> 'Feature Extraction'; straight arrow 'Feature Extraction' -> 'Feature Selection'; straight arrow 'Feature Selection' -> 'Classification'; straight arrow 'Classification' -> 'Classifier Output'. A small white mouse-cursor arrow icon (screen-capture artifact) sits on the arrow between 'Feature Extraction' and 'Feature Selection'.
